leadHtml:
COACH V0.27.0 COMPLETE

@fzlt/core/coach

The hints and tutorial layer the board games share, in three small parts: - flag: a once-only switch kept in localStorage ("tips off", "seen the tour"). Every read and write is wrapped in try/catch, so a page with storage blocked (private mode, sandboxed iframe, quota) just reads "not set" and plays on; - tour: DOM-free tutorial steps. It counts time on the current step, moves on when the game says the step is done (coach:step on the event ring), then cycles tips every every seconds. show() says which card to draw only when it changed, so the DOM is written once per card; - card: the Board UI kit card that shows it (count, title, text, an End button) and rings the control it is about. Its look is DOM Battlefield's coach card, inline on the kit tokens. Defaults are DOM Battlefield Blitz's practice coach (10 steps, then a tip every 6 s), so a port keeps its pace. tour steps without allocating; call it from a step like the rest of the game.

const tips = flag("my-game:tips", "off"); // localStorage, never throws
const t = tour(e), c = card(root, { onEnd: quit });
t.tick(dt); if (moved > 220) t.pass(); // in a step
const k = t.show(); if (k >= 0) c.show(`${k + 1}/10`, STEPS[k], TEXT[k]);

Options for tour(): how many tutorial steps, then how many tips and how often.

export interface TourOptions {
    /** Tutorial steps (default 10). */

    /** Tips shown in turn after the last step (default 7), one every `every` seconds (default 6). */

}
